purpose: Teach: 夢想/貪欲/空虚/アクシデント/を通じまして/うねり/交わり/地平線

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業者の夢想を現実の事業に落とし込め
lines.en: I want to see our founders' vision realized in actual business operations.
lines.style: Clear, measured authority. Slightly forward lean on each imperative. Unhurried but no wasted breath. The tone of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場への貪欲な姿勢を保ち、新規領域に挑みます
lines.en: Yes. We'll maintain our hunger for the market and push into new territory.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive nod in the voice. Direct eye contact through the response. Steady and assured—confirming understanding without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の空虚感を防ぐため、対話の場を設けろ
lines.en: Make sure we create spaces where our people can actually talk to each other. I don't want them feeling hollow.
lines.style: Quieter than before, more personal. A pause before the final clause—he's identifying something he cares about. Not a directive, almost a plea.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場のアクシデントに備え、訓練を増やします
lines.en: Yes. We'll increase our readiness drills, especially in case of accidents on the floor.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. No inflation. The tone of someone taking a note that matters. Steady completion on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界団体のご縁を通じまして関係を築いて行け
lines.en: Build our relationships through the connections we have in the industry associations. That's where the trust lives.
lines.style: Deliberate and measured. Weight on 「関係を築いて」. He's not suggesting—he's instructing on something he's thought through. Composed but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。為替市場のうねりに合わせ、リスクヘッジを強めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll strengthen our hedging as the forex market moves. We can't let that shake us.
lines.style: Assured, slightly quicker than before. Familiar with this territory. The voice of someone who's absorbed the lesson and can speak it back without hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外企業との交わりを増やせ
lines.en: Increase how much we're working with overseas companies. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm, clean attack. No softening. The weight of finality—this is the line he wants embedded. Brief, definite.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地平線の先の海外市場を視野に置きます
lines.en: Yes. We're keeping our eyes on the overseas markets beyond the horizon.
lines.style: Warm closure. Slight upward lift on the final phrase—he's seeing something forward. Respectful but not stiff. The note of a subordinate who understands the vision.
